_doc: One file per place; see places_build.py. Amounts in PEN. The debt component and history are refreshed by pipeline/fetch_peru.py from the official source named below; edit wording here, not numbers.
name: Peru
publisher: Banco Central de Reserva del Perú (BCRP)
title: Peru Debt Clock: Live Public Sector Debt, Official Data
headline: non-financial public sector debt
subject: The Republic of Peru
sum_note: Peru's gross debt of the non-financial public sector (central, regional and local government, and non-financial public companies), quarter-end, from the Central Reserve Bank's statistics.
scope_note: This is the BCRP's series "Saldo de la deuda del sector público no financiero": the outstanding public debt of the non-financial public sector, domestic and external, in soles at each quarter-end. It covers the central government, regional and local governments and the non-financial public companies, and is gross. The BCRP publishes it quarterly in its statistical database, alongside the ministry's own public debt bulletin.
trend_why: We use the change over the latest twelve months rather than the latest period alone, because changes between single reporting dates swing with the issuance calendar and short-term borrowing.
legend: Peru's non-financial public sector debt is reported at period-end. Issuance happens in lumps at auctions and maturities, so the live number is a straight-line projection between official figures, shown here next to them.
cadence: Quarterly. The BCRP adds each quarter-end position to its statistical database a few weeks after the quarter ends.
after_text: , a few weeks after each quarter-end
next_update: The BCRP adds each quarter-end position to its statistical database a few weeks after the quarter ends; this page re-bases to it automatically on the next daily build after it appears.

population.source_name: World Bank, World Development Indicators, Population, total (SP.POP.TOTL), Peru, 2025 (UN Population Division and national statistical offices)
population.method_short: World Bank 2025 population estimate, all ages

components.label: Peru non-financial public sector debt
components.source_name: Banco Central de Reserva del Perú, Saldo de la deuda del sector público no financiero (PN03371FQ), million soles
components.source_locator: BCRP statistical database series PN03371FQ, quarterly; machine-readable through the BCRP series API
components.includes: Gross debt of the non-financial public sector, domestic and external, in soles: central, regional and local government and non-financial public companies. Public financial institutions and the Central Bank are not included.

extra_sources.name: Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas del Perú, Deuda pública
INEI, Instituto Nacional de Estadística e Informática

notes: Why the BCRP series: it is an official quarterly stock series with an open API, covering the whole non-financial public sector, so it is broader than central government alone.
Scope: this is the non-financial public sector, not only the central government, so it can differ from the Ministry of Economy and Finance's central-government figures.
Currency: Peruvian soles. The World Debt Clock converts at the US Treasury's quarter-end rate for the sol.
